name: Full Text Search
description: Search indexed cross-platform posts and articles with date, platform, and sentiment filters.

endpoint.label: Full Text Search Endpoint
endpoint.help: Trusted full_text_search API endpoint. Defaults to the bundled service URL.

timeoutSeconds.label: Request Timeout
timeoutSeconds.help: Maximum request duration in seconds. Defaults to 90.

maxContentChars.label: Maximum Content Characters
maxContentChars.help: Maximum full-text characters returned per result. Defaults to 4000.
